name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_EQUILIBRIUM_NUM_Q01 - Calculation of equilibrium constant Kc for ammonia synthesis

questiontext.text:
The following concentrations were obtained for the formation of \(\mathrm{NH_3}\) from \(\mathrm{N_2}\) and \(\mathrm{H_2}\) at equilibrium at \(500\text{ K}\): \([\mathrm{N_2}] = 1.5 \times 10^{-2}\text{ M}\), \([\mathrm{H_2}] = 3.0 \times 10^{-2}\text{ M}\), and \([\mathrm{NH_3}] = 1.2 \times 10^{-2}\text{ M}\). For the reaction \(\mathrm{N_2(g)} + 3\mathrm{H_2(g)} \rightleftharpoons 2\mathrm{NH_3(g)}\), what is the value of the equilibrium constant \(K_c\)?

\(500\text{ K}\) पर \(\mathrm{N_2}\) और \(\mathrm{H_2}\) से \(\mathrm{NH_3}\) के निर्माण के लिए साम्यावस्था पर निम्नलिखित सांद्रताएँ प्राप्त हुईं: \([\mathrm{N_2}] = 1.5 \times 10^{-2}\text{ M}\), \([\mathrm{H_2}] = 3.0 \times 10^{-2}\text{ M}\), तथा \([\mathrm{NH_3}] = 1.2 \times 10^{-2}\text{ M}\)। अभिक्रिया \(\mathrm{N_2(g)} + 3\mathrm{H_2(g)} \rightleftharpoons 2\mathrm{NH_3(g)}\) के लिए साम्य स्थिरांक \(K_c\) का मान क्या होगा?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1
Write the equilibrium expression: \(K_c = \frac{[\mathrm{NH_3}]^2}{[\mathrm{N_2}][\mathrm{H_2}]^3}\).

Step 2
Substitute the given values: \(K_c = \frac{(1.2 \times 10^{-2})^2}{(1.5 \times 10^{-2})(3.0 \times 10^{-2})^3} = \frac{1.44 \times 10^{-4}}{(1.5 \times 10^{-2})(2.7 \times 10^{-5})} = \frac{1.44 \times 10^{-4}}{4.05 \times 10^{-7}} \approx 355.6\text{ M}^{-2} = 3.56 \times 10^2\text{ M}^{-2}\).

Step 3: Final Answer
The equilibrium constant \(K_c\) is \(3.56 \times 10^2\text{ M}^{-2}\).

चरण 1
साम्य स्थिरांक व्यंजक: \(K_c = \frac{[\mathrm{NH_3}]^2}{[\mathrm{N_2}][\mathrm{H_2}]^3}\)।

चरण 2
दिए गए मान रखने पर: \(K_c = \frac{(1.2 \times 10^{-2})^2}{(1.5 \times 10^{-2})(3.0 \times 10^{-2})^3} = \frac{1.44 \times 10^{-4}}{4.05 \times 10^{-7}} \approx 3.56 \times 10^2\text{ M}^{-2}\)।

चरण 3: अंतिम उत्तर
साम्य स्थिरांक \(K_c\) का मान \(3.56 \times 10^2\text{ M}^{-2}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_EQUILIBRIUM_NUM_Q02 - Calculation of Kc for nitric oxide formation

questiontext.text:
At equilibrium in a sealed vessel at \(800\text{ K}\), the concentrations are \([\mathrm{N_2}] = 3.0 \times 10^{-3}\text{ M}\), \([\mathrm{O_2}] = 4.2 \times 10^{-3}\text{ M}\), and \([\mathrm{NO}] = 2.8 \times 10^{-3}\text{ M}\). What is the value of \(K_c\) for the reaction \(\mathrm{N_2(g)} + \mathrm{O_2(g)} \rightleftharpoons 2\mathrm{NO(g)}\)?

\(800\text{ K}\) पर एक बंद पात्र में साम्यावस्था पर सांद्रताएँ \([\mathrm{N_2}] = 3.0 \times 10^{-3}\text{ M}\), \([\mathrm{O_2}] = 4.2 \times 10^{-3}\text{ M}\), तथा \([\mathrm{NO}] = 2.8 \times 10^{-3}\text{ M}\) हैं। अभिक्रिया \(\mathrm{N_2(g)} + \mathrm{O_2(g)} \rightleftharpoons 2\mathrm{NO(g)}\) के लिए \(K_c\) का मान क्या होगा?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1
Write the equilibrium constant equation: \(K_c = \frac{[\mathrm{NO}]^2}{[\mathrm{N_2}][\mathrm{O_2}]}\).

Step 2
Substitute the values: \(K_c = \frac{(2.8 \times 10^{-3})^2}{(3.0 \times 10^{-3})(4.2 \times 10^{-3})} = \frac{7.84 \times 10^{-6}}{1.26 \times 10^{-5}} \approx 0.622\).

Step 3: Final Answer
The value of \(K_c\) is \(0.622\).

चरण 1
साम्य स्थिरांक समीकरण: \(K_c = \frac{[\mathrm{NO}]^2}{[\mathrm{N_2}][\mathrm{O_2}]}\)।

चरण 2
मान रखने पर: \(K_c = \frac{(2.8 \times 10^{-3})^2}{(3.0 \times 10^{-3})(4.2 \times 10^{-3})} = \frac{7.84 \times 10^{-6}}{1.26 \times 10^{-5}} \approx 0.622\)।

चरण 3: अंतिम उत्तर
साम्य स्थिरांक \(K_c\) का मान \(0.622\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_EQUILIBRIUM_NUM_Q03 - Equilibrium constant Kc for sulfur trioxide synthesis

questiontext.text:
What is \(K_c\) for the equilibrium \(2\mathrm{SO_2(g)} + \mathrm{O_2(g)} \rightleftharpoons 2\mathrm{SO_3(g)}\) when the equilibrium concentrations are: \([\mathrm{SO_2}] = 0.60\text{ M}\), \([\mathrm{O_2}] = 0.82\text{ M}\), and \([\mathrm{SO_3}] = 1.90\text{ M}\)?

साम्यावस्था \(2\mathrm{SO_2(g)} + \mathrm{O_2(g)} \rightleftharpoons 2\mathrm{SO_3(g)}\) के लिए \(K_c\) का मान क्या होगा जब साम्य सांद्रताएँ \([\mathrm{SO_2}] = 0.60\text{ M}\), \([\mathrm{O_2}] = 0.82\text{ M}\), तथा \([\mathrm{SO_3}] = 1.90\text{ M}\) हैं?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1
Equilibrium expression: \(K_c = \frac{[\mathrm{SO_3}]^2}{[\mathrm{SO_2}]^2 [\mathrm{O_2}]}\).

Step 2
Substitute the values: \(K_c = \frac{(1.90)^2}{(0.60)^2 \times 0.82} = \frac{3.61}{0.36 \times 0.82} = \frac{3.61}{0.2952} \approx 12.23\text{ M}^{-1}\).

Step 3: Final Answer
The equilibrium constant \(K_c\) is approximately \(12.22\text{ M}^{-1}\).

चरण 1
साम्य व्यंजक: \(K_c = \frac{[\mathrm{SO_3}]^2}{[\mathrm{SO_2}]^2 [\mathrm{O_2}]}\)।

चरण 2
मान रखने पर: \(K_c = \frac{(1.90)^2}{(0.60)^2 \times 0.82} = \frac{3.61}{0.2952} \approx 12.22\text{ M}^{-1}\)।

चरण 3: अंतिम उत्तर
साम्य स्थिरांक \(K_c\) का मान लगभग \(12.22\text{ M}^{-1}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_EQUILIBRIUM_NUM_Q04 - pH of soft drink sample from hydrogen ion concentration

questiontext.text:
The concentration of hydrogen ions in a sample of soft drink is \(3.8 \times 10^{-3}\text{ M}\). Given \(\log_{10}(3.8) = 0.58\), what is its pH?

शीतल पेय के एक नमूने में हाइड्रोजन आयन की सांद्रता \(3.8 \times 10^{-3}\text{ M}\) है। दिया गया है \(\log_{10}(3.8) = 0.58\), इसका pH क्या होगा?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1
Definition of pH: \(\text{pH} = -\log_{10}[\mathrm{H^+}]\).

Step 2
Substitute: \(\text{pH} = -\log_{10}(3.8 \times 10^{-3}) = -[\log_{10}(3.8) + \log_{10}(10^{-3})] = -[0.58 - 3] = 3 - 0.58 = 2.42\).

Step 3: Final Answer
The pH of the soft drink is \(2.42\).

चरण 1
pH की परिभाषा: \(\text{pH} = -\log_{10}[\mathrm{H^+}]\)।

चरण 2
मान प्रतिस्थापित करने पर: \(\text{pH} = -[0.58 - 3] = 2.42\)।

चरण 3: अंतिम उत्तर
शीतल पेय का pH \(2.42\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_EQUILIBRIUM_NUM_Q05 - Calculation of Kc for phosphorus pentachloride dissociation

questiontext.text:
At \(500\text{ K}\), an equilibrium mixture for \(\mathrm{PCl_5(g)} \rightleftharpoons \mathrm{PCl_3(g)} + \mathrm{Cl_2(g)}\) contains \([\mathrm{PCl_3}] = 1.59\text{ M}\), \([\mathrm{Cl_2}] = 1.59\text{ M}\), and \([\mathrm{PCl_5}] = 1.41\text{ M}\). What is the equilibrium constant \(K_c\)?

\(500\text{ K}\) पर, \(\mathrm{PCl_5(g)} \rightleftharpoons \mathrm{PCl_3(g)} + \mathrm{Cl_2(g)}\) के साम्य मिश्रण में \([\mathrm{PCl_3}] = 1.59\text{ M}\), \([\mathrm{Cl_2}] = 1.59\text{ M}\), तथा \([\mathrm{PCl_5}] = 1.41\text{ M}\) उपस्थित हैं। साम्य स्थिरांक \(K_c\) का मान क्या होगा?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1
Write the equilibrium constant equation: \(K_c = \frac{[\mathrm{PCl_3}][\mathrm{Cl_2}]}{[\\mathrm{PCl_5}]}\).

Step 2
Substitute the equilibrium concentrations: \(K_c = \frac{(1.59)^2}{1.41} = \frac{2.5281}{1.41} \approx 1.79\text{ M}\).

Step 3: Final Answer
The equilibrium constant \(K_c\) is \(1.79\text{ M}\).

चरण 1
साम्य स्थिरांक व्यंजक: \(K_c = \frac{[\mathrm{PCl_3}][\mathrm{Cl_2}]}{[\\mathrm{PCl_5}]}\)।

चरण 2
सांद्रताएँ रखने पर: \(K_c = \frac{(1.59)^2}{1.41} = 1.79\text{ M}\)।

चरण 3: अंतिम उत्तर
साम्य स्थिरांक \(K_c\) का मान \(1.79\text{ M}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_EQUILIBRIUM_NUM_Q06 - Calculation of Kp from Kc for nitrosyl chloride dissociation

questiontext.text:
For the equilibrium \(2\mathrm{NOCl(g)} \rightleftharpoons 2\mathrm{NO(g)} + \mathrm{Cl_2(g)}\), the value of \(K_c\) is \(3.75 \times 10^{-6}\text{ M}\) at \(1069\text{ K}\). Taking \(R = 0.0831\text{ bar}\cdot\text{L}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\cdot\text{K}^{-1}\), what is the value of \(K_p\)?

साम्यावस्था \(2\mathrm{NOCl(g)} \rightleftharpoons 2\mathrm{NO(g)} + \mathrm{Cl_2(g)}\) के लिए \(1069\text{ K}\) पर \(K_c\) का मान \(3.75 \times 10^{-6}\text{ M}\) है। \(R = 0.0831\text{ bar}\cdot\text{L}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\cdot\text{K}^{-1}\) लेते हुए, \(K_p\) का मान क्या होगा?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1
Relationship between \(K_p\) and \(K_c\): \(K_p = K_c (RT)^{\Delta n_g}\), where \(\Delta n_g = (2+1) - 2 = 1\).

Step 2
Substitute: \(K_p = 3.75 \times 10^{-6} \times (0.0831 \times 1069)^1 = 3.75 \times 10^{-6} \times 88.834 \approx 0.0333\text{ bar} = 0.033\text{ bar}\).

Step 3: Final Answer
The equilibrium constant \(K_p\) is \(0.033\text{ bar}\).

चरण 1
\(K_p\) और \(K_c\) में संबंध: \(K_p = K_c(RT)^{\Delta n_g}\), जहाँ \(\Delta n_g = 3 - 2 = 1\)।

चरण 2
मान रखने पर: \(K_p = 3.75 \times 10^{-6} \times (0.0831 \times 1069) \approx 0.033\text{ bar}\)।

चरण 3: अंतिम उत्तर
साम्य स्थिरांक \(K_p\) का मान \(0.033\text{ bar}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_EQUILIBRIUM_NUM_Q07 - Partial pressures and Kp for ammonium hydrogen sulfide

questiontext.text:
Solid ammonium hydrogen sulfide dissociates as \(\mathrm{NH_4HS(s)} \rightleftharpoons \mathrm{NH_3(g)} + \mathrm{H_2S(g)}\). If the total pressure at equilibrium in a closed vessel is \(1.12\text{ bar}\), what is the value of \(K_p\)?

ठोस अमोनियम हाइड्रोजन सल्फाइड \(\mathrm{NH_4HS(s)} \rightleftharpoons \mathrm{NH_3(g)} + \mathrm{H_2S(g)}\) के अनुसार वियोजित होता है। यदि बंद पात्र में साम्यावस्था पर कुल दाब \(1.12\text{ bar}\) है, तो \(K_p\) का मान क्या होगा?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1
Equimolar quantities of gaseous products are formed: \(p_{\mathrm{NH_3}} = p_{\mathrm{H_2S}} = p\). Total pressure \(P = 2p = 1.12\text{ bar} \implies p = 0.56\text{ bar}\).

Step 2
\(K_p = p_{\mathrm{NH_3}} \times p_{\mathrm{H_2S}} = (0.56)^2 = 0.3136\text{ bar}^2 \approx 0.314\text{ bar}^2\).

Step 3: Final Answer
The equilibrium constant \(K_p\) is \(0.314\text{ bar}^2\).

चरण 1
गैसीय उत्पादों के मोल समान हैं: \(p_{\mathrm{NH_3}} = p_{\mathrm{H_2S}} = p\)। कुल दाब \(2p = 1.12\text{ bar} \implies p = 0.56\text{ bar}\)।

चरण 2
\(K_p = (0.56)^2 = 0.3136\text{ bar}^2 \approx 0.314\text{ bar}^2\)।

चरण 3: अंतिम उत्तर
साम्य स्थिरांक \(K_p\) का मान \(0.314\text{ bar}^2\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_EQUILIBRIUM_NUM_Q08 - Standard Gibbs free energy change from equilibrium constant

questiontext.text:
Hydrolysis of sucrose has an equilibrium constant \(K_c = 2.0 \times 10^{13}\) at \(300\text{ K}\). What is the standard Gibbs energy change \(\Delta_{\mathrm{r}}G^\circ\)? (Take \(R = 8.314\text{ J}\cdot\text{K}^{-1}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\) and \(\ln(2.0 \times 10^{13}) = 30.63\))

\(300\text{ K}\) पर सुक्रोज के जल-अपघटन के लिए साम्य स्थिरांक \(K_c = 2.0 \times 10^{13}\) है। मानक गिब्स मुक्त ऊर्जा परिवर्तन \(\Delta_{\mathrm{r}}G^\circ\) क्या होगा? (\(R = 8.314\text{ J}\cdot\text{K}^{-1}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\) तथा \(\ln(2.0 \times 10^{13}) = 30.63\) लें)

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1
Thermodynamic relation: \(\Delta_{\mathrm{r}}G^\circ = -RT \ln K_c\).

Step 2
Substitute: \(\Delta_{\mathrm{r}}G^\circ = -8.314 \times 300 \times 30.63 = -2494.2 \times 30.63 \approx -76397\text{ J}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1} = -7.64 \times 10^4\text{ J}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\).

Step 3: Final Answer
The standard Gibbs energy change is \(-7.64 \times 10^4\text{ J}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\).

चरण 1
ऊष्मागतिकी संबंध: \(\Delta_{\mathrm{r}}G^\circ = -RT \ln K_c\)।

चरण 2
गणना: मान रखने पर: \(\Delta_{\mathrm{r}}G^\circ = -8.314 \times 300 \times 30.63 \approx -7.64 \times 10^4\text{ J}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\)।

चरण 3: अंतिम उत्तर
मानक गिब्स मुक्त ऊर्जा परिवर्तन \(-7.64 \times 10^4\text{ J}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_EQUILIBRIUM_NUM_Q09 - Ionization constant Ka from pH and concentration of monobasic acid

questiontext.text:
The pH of a \(0.10\text{ M}\) monobasic acid \(\mathrm{HA}\) solution is \(4.50\). Given \(10^{-4.50} = 3.16 \times 10^{-5}\), what is the acid dissociation constant \(K_a\)?

एक \(0.10\text{ M}\) एकक्षारकीय अम्ल \(\mathrm{HA}\) विलयन का pH \(4.50\) है। दिया गया है \(10^{-4.50} = 3.16 \times 10^{-5}\), अम्ल वियोजन स्थिरांक \(K_a\) क्या होगा?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1
From pH: \([\mathrm{H^+}] = [\mathrm{A^-}] = 10^{-\text{pH}} = 10^{-4.50} = 3.16 \times 10^{-5}\text{ M}\). Since dissociation is very small, \([\mathrm{HA}] \approx 0.10\text{ M}\).

Step 2
\(K_a = \frac{[\mathrm{H^+}][\mathrm{A^-}]}{[\mathrm{HA}]} = \frac{(3.16 \times 10^{-5})^2}{0.10} = \frac{1.0 \times 10^{-9}}{0.10} = 1.0 \times 10^{-8}\).

Step 3: Final Answer
The ionization constant \(K_a\) is \(1.0 \times 10^{-8}\).

चरण 1
\([\mathrm{H^+}] = [\mathrm{A^-}] = 10^{-4.50} = 3.16 \times 10^{-5}\text{ M}\)। \([\mathrm{HA}] \approx 0.10\text{ M}\)।

चरण 2
\(K_a = \frac{(3.16 \times 10^{-5})^2}{0.10} = 1.0 \times 10^{-8}\)।

चरण 3: अंतिम उत्तर
आयनन स्थिरांक \(K_a\) का मान \(1.0 \times 10^{-8}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_EQUILIBRIUM_NUM_Q10 - Percent dissociation and pH of hypochlorous acid

questiontext.text:
Hypochlorous acid (\(\mathrm{HOCl}\)) in a \(0.08\text{ M}\) solution has an ionization constant \(K_a = 2.5 \times 10^{-5}\). Given \(\sqrt{2.0} \approx 1.41\) and \(\log_{10}(1.41) \approx 0.15\), what are its percent dissociation and pH, respectively?

\(0.08\text{ M}\) हाइपोक्लोरस अम्ल (\(\mathrm{HOCl}\)) का आयनन स्थिरांक \(K_a = 2.5 \times 10^{-5}\) है। \(\sqrt{2.0} \approx 1.41\) तथा \(\log_{10}(1.41) \approx 0.15\) लेते हुए, इसका प्रतिशत वियोजन तथा pH क्रमशः क्या हैं?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1
Since \(\alpha \ll 1\), \([\mathrm{H^+}] = \sqrt{K_a \cdot c} = \sqrt{2.5 \times 10^{-5} \times 0.08} = \sqrt{2.0 \times 10^{-6}} = 1.41 \times 10^{-3}\text{ M}\).

Step 2
Percent dissociation \(= \frac{[\mathrm{H^+}]}{c} \times 100 = \frac{1.41 \times 10^{-3}}{0.08} \times 100 = 1.76\%\). \(\text{pH} = -\log_{10}(1.41 \times 10^{-3}) = 3 - 0.15 = 2.85\).

Step 3: Final Answer
The percent dissociation is \(1.76\%\) and the pH is \(2.85\).

चरण 1
\([\mathrm{H^+}] = \sqrt{K_a \cdot c} = \sqrt{2.5 \times 10^{-5} \times 0.08} = 1.41 \times 10^{-3}\text{ M}\)।

चरण 2
प्रतिशत वियोजन \(= \frac{1.41 \times 10^{-3}}{0.08} \times 100 = 1.76\%\)। \(\text{pH} = 3 - 0.15 = 2.85\)।

चरण 3: अंतिम उत्तर
प्रतिशत वियोजन \(1.76\%\) तथा pH \(2.85\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_EQUILIBRIUM_NUM_Q11 - Base dissociation constant Kb of hydrazine from pH

questiontext.text:
The pH of a \(0.004\text{ M}\) hydrazine (\(\mathrm{NH_2NH_2}\)) solution is \(9.70\) at \(298\text{ K}\). Taking \(K_w = 1.0 \times 10^{-14}\) and \(10^{-9.70} = 1.67 \times 10^{-10}\), what is the ionization constant \(K_b\)?

\(298\text{ K}\) पर \(0.004\text{ M}\) हाइड्राजीन (\(\mathrm{NH_2NH_2}\)) विलयन का pH \(9.70\) है। \(K_w = 1.0 \times 10^{-14}\) तथा \(10^{-9.70} = 1.67 \times 10^{-10}\) लेते हुए, आयनन स्थिरांक \(K_b\) का मान क्या होगा?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1
\([\mathrm{H^+}] = 1.67 \times 10^{-10}\text{ M}\). \([\mathrm{OH^-}] = \frac{K_w}{[\mathrm{H^+}]} = \frac{1.0 \times 10^{-14}}{1.67 \times 10^{-10}} \approx 5.98 \times 10^{-5}\text{ M}\).

Step 2
\(K_b = \frac{[\mathrm{NH_2NH_3^+}][\mathrm{OH^-}]}{[\mathrm{NH_2NH_2}]} = \frac{(5.98 \times 10^{-5})^2}{0.004} = \frac{3.576 \times 10^{-9}}{0.004} \approx 8.96 \times 10^{-7}\).

Step 3: Final Answer
The ionization constant \(K_b\) is \(8.96 \times 10^{-7}\).

चरण 1
\([\mathrm{OH^-}] = \frac{1.0 \times 10^{-14}}{1.67 \times 10^{-10}} \approx 5.98 \times 10^{-5}\text{ M}\)।

चरण 2
\(K_b = \frac{(5.98 \times 10^{-5})^2}{0.004} \approx 8.96 \times 10^{-7}\)।

चरण 3: अंतिम उत्तर
आयनन स्थिरांक \(K_b\) का मान \(8.96 \times 10^{-7}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_EQUILIBRIUM_NUM_Q12 - Degree of ionization and pH of aqueous ammonia solution

questiontext.text:
Given \(K_b(\mathrm{NH_3}) = 1.77 \times 10^{-5}\) and \(K_w = 1.0 \times 10^{-14}\), what are the degree of ionization (\(\alpha\)) and the pH of a \(0.05\text{ M}\) aqueous ammonia solution? (Take \(\log_{10}(1.06) \approx 0.03\))

\(K_b(\mathrm{NH_3}) = 1.77 \times 10^{-5}\) तथा \(K_w = 1.0 \times 10^{-14}\) दिया गया है। \(0.05\text{ M}\) जलीय अमोनिया विलयन के आयनन की मात्रा (\(\alpha\)) तथा pH क्या होंगे? (\(\log_{10}(1.06) \approx 0.03\) लें)

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1
For weak base: \(\alpha = \sqrt{\frac{K_b}{c}} = \sqrt{\frac{1.77 \times 10^{-5}}{0.05}} = \sqrt{3.54 \times 10^{-4}} \approx 0.0188\).

Step 2
\([\mathrm{OH^-}] = c\alpha = 0.05 \times 0.0188 = 9.40 \times 10^{-4}\text{ M}\). \([\mathrm{H^+}] = \frac{10^{-14}}{9.40 \times 10^{-4}} = 1.06 \times 10^{-11}\text{ M}\).

Step 3: Final Answer
\(\text{pH} = -\log_{10}(1.06 \times 10^{-11}) = 11 - 0.03 = 10.97\). The values are \(\alpha = 0.0188\) and \(\text{pH} = 10.97\).

चरण 1
\(\alpha = \sqrt{\frac{1.77 \times 10^{-5}}{0.05}} \approx 0.0188\)।

चरण 2
\([\mathrm{OH^-}] = 9.40 \times 10^{-4}\text{ M}\)। \([\mathrm{H^+}] = 1.06 \times 10^{-11}\text{ M}\)।

चरण 3: अंतिम उत्तर
\(\text{pH} = 11 - 0.03 = 10.97\)। अतः \(\alpha = 0.0188\) तथा \(\text{pH} = 10.97\)।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_EQUILIBRIUM_NUM_Q13 - Molar solubility of barium sulfate from solubility product

questiontext.text:
The solubility product constant \(K_{\mathrm{sp}}\) of barium sulfate (\(\mathrm{BaSO_4}\)) is \(1.1 \times 10^{-10}\) at \(298\text{ K}\). Given \(\sqrt{1.1} \approx 1.05\), what is its molar solubility in pure water?

\(298\text{ K}\) पर बेरियम सल्फेट (\(\mathrm{BaSO_4}\)) का विलेयता गुणनफल \(K_{\mathrm{sp}} = 1.1 \times 10^{-10}\) है। \(\sqrt{1.1} \approx 1.05\) दिया गया है, शुद्ध जल में इसकी मोलर विलेयता क्या होगी?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1
\(\mathrm{BaSO_4(s)} \rightleftharpoons \mathrm{Ba^{2+}(aq)} + \mathrm{SO_4^{2-}(aq)}\).

Step 2
Let molar solubility be \(S\). Then \(K_{\mathrm{sp}} = [\mathrm{Ba^{2+}][\mathrm{SO_4^{2-}}] = S^2\). Thus, \(S = \sqrt{K_{\mathrm{sp}}} = \sqrt{1.1 \times 10^{-10}} = 1.05 \times 10^{-5}\text{ mol}\cdot\text{L}^{-1}\).

Step 3: Final Answer
The molar solubility is \(1.05 \times 10^{-5}\text{ mol}\cdot\text{L}^{-1}\).

चरण 1
\(\mathrm{BaSO_4(s)} \rightleftharpoons \mathrm{Ba^{2+}(aq)} + \mathrm{SO_4^{2-}(aq)}\)।

चरण 2
\(K_{\mathrm{sp}} = S^2 \implies S = \sqrt{1.1 \times 10^{-10}} = 1.05 \times 10^{-5}\text{ mol}\cdot\text{L}^{-1}\)।

चरण 3: अंतिम उत्तर
मोलर विलेयता \(1.05 \times 10^{-5}\text{ mol}\cdot\text{L}^{-1}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_EQUILIBRIUM_NUM_Q14 - Common ion effect of sodium chloride on silver chloride solubility

questiontext.text:
The solubility product constant \(K_{\mathrm{sp}}\) of \(\mathrm{AgCl}\) is \(1.8 \times 10^{-10}\) at \(298\text{ K}\). What is its molar solubility in a \(0.10\text{ M }\mathrm{NaCl}\) solution?

\(298\text{ K}\) पर \(\mathrm{AgCl}\) का विलेयता गुणनफल \(K_{\mathrm{sp}} = 1.8 \times 10^{-10}\) है। \(0.10\text{ M }\\mathrm{NaCl}\) विलयन में इसकी मोलर विलेयता क्या होगी?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1
\(\mathrm{NaCl}\) provides complete dissociation: \([\mathrm{Cl^-}] = 0.10\text{ M}\). The contribution of \(\mathrm{Cl^-}\) from \(\mathrm{AgCl}\) is negligible.

Step 2
\(K_{\mathrm{sp}} = [\mathrm{Ag^+}][\mathrm{Cl^-}] = S \times 0.10 = 1.8 \times 10^{-10} \implies S = \frac{1.8 \times 10^{-10}}{0.10} = 1.8 \times 10^{-9}\text{ M}\).

Step 3: Final Answer
The molar solubility is \(1.8 \times 10^{-9}\text{ M}\).

चरण 1
\(\mathrm{NaCl}\) से \([\mathrm{Cl^-}] = 0.10\text{ M}\)। \(\mathrm{AgCl}\) से प्राप्त \(\mathrm{Cl^-}\) नगण्य है।

चरण 2
\(K_{\mathrm{sp}} = S \times 0.10 = 1.8 \times 10^{-10} \implies S = 1.8 \times 10^{-9}\text{ M}\)।

चरण 3: अंतिम उत्तर
मोलर विलेयता \(1.8 \times 10^{-9}\text{ M}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_EQUILIBRIUM_NUM_Q15 - Equilibrium partial pressures in carbon carbon dioxide heterogeneous system

questiontext.text:
The value of \(K_p\) for \(\mathrm{CO_2(g)} + \mathrm{C(s)} \rightleftharpoons 2\mathrm{CO(g)}\) is \(3.0\) at \(1000\text{ K}\). If initially \(p_{\mathrm{CO_2}} = 0.48\text{ bar}\), \(p_{\mathrm{CO}} = 0\text{ bar}\), and excess pure graphite is present, what is the equilibrium partial pressure of \(\mathrm{CO}\)?

\(1000\text{ K}\) पर अभिक्रिया \(\mathrm{CO_2(g)} + \mathrm{C(s)} \rightleftharpoons 2\mathrm{CO(g)}\) के लिए \(K_p = 3.0\) है। यदि प्रारंभिक में \(p_{\mathrm{CO_2}} = 0.48\text{ bar}\), \(p_{\mathrm{CO}} = 0\text{ bar}\) तथा आधिक्य ग्रेफाइट उपस्थित हो, तो साम्यावस्था पर \(\mathrm{CO}\) का आंशिक दाब क्या होगा?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1
Let \(x\) be the decrease in pressure of \(\mathrm{CO_2}\). At equilibrium: \(p_{\mathrm{CO_2}} = 0.48 - x\) and \(p_{\mathrm{CO}} = 2x\).

Step 2
\(K_p = \frac{p_{\mathrm{CO}}^2}{p_{\mathrm{CO_2}}} = \frac{(2x)^2}{0.48 - x} = 3.0 \implies 4x^2 + 3x - 1.44 = 0\). Solving: \(x = \frac{-3 + \sqrt{9 - 4(4)(-1.44)}}{8} = \frac{-3 + \sqrt{32.04}}{8} = \frac{-3 + 5.66}{8} = 0.3325 \approx 0.33\text{ bar}\).

Step 3: Final Answer
The equilibrium partial pressure of \(\mathrm{CO}\) is \(p_{\mathrm{CO}} = 2x = 2 \times 0.33 = 0.66\text{ bar}\).

चरण 1
माना \(\mathrm{CO_2}\) के दाब में कमी \(x\) है। साम्य पर: \(p_{\mathrm{CO_2}} = 0.48 - x\) तथा \(p_{\mathrm{CO}} = 2x\)।

चरण 2
\(K_p = \frac{(2x)^2}{0.48 - x} = 3.0 \implies 4x^2 + 3x - 1.44 = 0\)। हल करने पर धनात्मक मूल: \(x \approx 0.33\text{ bar}\)।

चरण 3: अंतिम उत्तर
\(\mathrm{CO}\) का साम्य आंशिक दाब \(p_{\mathrm{CO}} = 2x = 0.66\text{ bar}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_EQUILIBRIUM_NUM_Q16 - Calculation of pH for extremely dilute hydrochloric acid

questiontext.text:
Calculate the pH of a \(1.0 \times 10^{-8}\text{ M}\) aqueous solution of \(\mathrm{HCl}\) at \(298\text{ K}\), accounting for the auto-ionization of water (\(K_w = 1.0 \times 10^{-14}\)). (Take \(\sqrt{401} \approx 20.025\) and \(\log_{10}(1.05) \approx 0.02\))

जल के स्वतः आयनन (\(K_w = 1.0 \times 10^{-14}\)) को ध्यान में रखते हुए, \(298\text{ K}\) पर \(1.0 \times 10^{-8}\text{ M }\mathrm{HCl}\) के जलीय विलयन का pH ज्ञात कीजिए। (\(\log_{10}(1.05) \approx 0.02\) लें)

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1
Let \(x\) be \([\mathrm{H_3O^+}]\) from water. Total \([\mathrm{H_3O^+}] = 10^{-8} + x\) and \([\mathrm{OH^-}] = x\).

Step 2
\(K_w = (10^{-8} + x)x = 10^{-14} \implies x^2 + 10^{-8}x - 10^{-14} = 0\). Solving gives \(x = 9.51 \times 10^{-8}\text{ M}\). Total \([\mathrm{H_3O^+}] = 1.0 \times 10^{-8} + 9.51 \times 10^{-8} = 1.051 \times 10^{-7}\text{ M}\).

Step 3: Final Answer
\(\text{pH} = -\log_{10}(1.051 \times 10^{-7}) = 7 - 0.02 = 6.98\). The pH is \(6.98\).

चरण 1
माना जल से \([\mathrm{H_3O^+}] = x\)। कुल \([\mathrm{H_3O^+}] = 10^{-8} + x\) तथा \([\mathrm{OH^-}] = x\)।

चरण 2
\(x(10^{-8} + x) = 10^{-14} \implies x \approx 9.51 \times 10^{-8}\text{ M}\)। कुल \([\mathrm{H_3O^+}] = 1.051 \times 10^{-7}\text{ M}\)।

चरण 3: अंतिम उत्तर
\(\text{pH} = 7 - \log_{10}(1.051) \approx 6.98\)। विलयन का pH \(6.98\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_EQUILIBRIUM_NUM_Q17 - Degree of dissociation of weak hydrofluoric acid by quadratic formula

questiontext.text:
The ionization constant of hydrofluoric acid is \(K_a = 3.2 \times 10^{-4}\). For a \(0.02\text{ M}\) solution of \(\mathrm{HF}\), determine the degree of dissociation (\(\alpha\)) and the solution pH without neglecting \(\alpha\) in the denominator. (Given \(\log_{10}(2.4) \approx 0.38\))

हाइड्रोफ्लोरोइक अम्ल का आयनन स्थिरांक \(K_a = 3.2 \times 10^{-4}\) है। \(\mathrm{HF}\) के \(0.02\text{ M}\) विलयन के लिए, हर में \(\alpha\) की उपेक्षा किए बिना वियोजन की मात्रा (\(\alpha\)) और pH ज्ञात कीजिए। (\(\log_{10}(2.4) \approx 0.38\) लें)

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1
\(K_a = \frac{c\alpha^2}{1-\alpha} = \frac{0.02\alpha^2}{1-\alpha} = 3.2 \times 10^{-4} \implies \alpha^2 + 0.016\alpha - 0.016 = 0\).

Step 2
Solving: \(\alpha = \frac{-0.016 + \sqrt{(0.016)^2 - 4(1)(-0.016)}}{2} = \frac{-0.016 + \sqrt{0.000256 + 0.064}}{2} = \frac{-0.016 + 0.2535}{2} \approx 0.119 \approx 0.12\). Then \([\mathrm{H^+}] = c\alpha = 0.02 \times 0.12 = 2.4 \times 10^{-3}\text{ M}\).

Step 3: Final Answer
\(\text{pH} = -\log_{10}(2.4 \times 10^{-3}) = 3 - 0.38 = 2.62\). The degree of dissociation is \(0.12\) and the pH is \(2.62\).

चरण 1
\(K_a = \frac{0.02\alpha^2}{1-\alpha} = 3.2 \times 10^{-4} \implies \alpha^2 + 0.016\alpha - 0.016 = 0\)।

चरण 2
हल करने पर: \(\alpha \approx 0.12\)। \([\mathrm{H^+}] = 0.02 \times 0.12 = 2.4 \times 10^{-3}\text{ M}\)।

चरण 3: अंतिम उत्तर
\(\text{pH} = 3 - 0.38 = 2.62\)। अतः \(\alpha = 0.12\) तथा \(\text{pH} = 2.62\)।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_EQUILIBRIUM_NUM_Q18 - Buffer solution pH from ammonia and hydrochloric acid titration

questiontext.text:
A solution is prepared by mixing \(50.0\text{ mL}\) of \(0.10\text{ M }\\mathrm{NH_3}\) with \(25.0\text{ mL}\) of \(0.10\text{ M }\\mathrm{HCl}\). Given \(K_b(\mathrm{NH_3}) = 1.77 \times 10^{-5}\) and \(-\log_{10}(1.77 \times 10^{-5}) = 4.75\), what is the pH of the resulting solution at \(298\text{ K}\)?

\(0.10\text{ M }\\mathrm{NH_3}\) के \(50.0\text{ mL}\) को \(0.10\text{ M }\\mathrm{HCl}\) के \(25.0\text{ mL}\) के साथ मिलाया जाता है। \(K_b(\mathrm{NH_3}) = 1.77 \times 10^{-5}\) तथा \(\mathrm{p}K_b = 4.75\) दिया गया है। \(298\text{ K}\) पर परिणामी विलयन का pH क्या होगा?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1
Initial: \(\mathrm{NH_3} = 50.0 \times 0.10 = 5.0\text{ mmol}\), \(\mathrm{HCl} = 25.0 \times 0.10 = 2.5\text{ mmol}\). Reaction consumes \(2.5\text{ mmol }\\mathrm{HCl}\) and produces \(2.5\text{ mmol }\\mathrm{NH_4^+}\), leaving \(2.5\text{ mmol }\\mathrm{NH_3}\) in \(75\text{ mL}\).

Step 2
Since \([\mathrm{NH_4^+}] = [\mathrm{NH_3}] = \frac{2.5}{75}\text{ M}\), \(\text{pOH} = \mathrm{p}K_b + \log(1) = 4.75 + 0 = 4.75\). Then \(\text{pH} = 14.00 - 4.75 = 9.25\).

Step 3: Final Answer
The pH of the resulting buffer solution is \(9.25\).

चरण 1
प्रारंभिक: \(\mathrm{NH_3} = 5.0\text{ mmol}\), \(\mathrm{HCl} = 2.5\text{ mmol}\)। अभिक्रिया के बाद \(2.5\text{ mmol }\\mathrm{NH_4^+}\) बनता है तथा \(2.5\text{ mmol }\\mathrm{NH_3}\) शेष रहता है।

चरण 2
\([\mathrm{NH_4^+}] = [\mathrm{NH_3}]\) होने से \(\text{pOH} = \mathrm{p}K_b = 4.75\)। \(\text{pH} = 14.00 - 4.75 = 9.25\)।

चरण 3: अंतिम उत्तर
परिणामी बफर विलयन का pH \(9.25\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_EQUILIBRIUM_NUM_Q19 - Solubility of sparingly soluble A2X3 salt from solubility product

questiontext.text:
The solubility product of a sparingly soluble salt \(\mathrm{A_2X_3}\) in pure water is \(K_{\mathrm{sp}} = 1.1 \times 10^{-23}\). Assuming neither ion undergoes hydrolysis, what is the molar solubility of \(\mathrm{A_2X_3}\)? (Take \(1.1 / 108 \approx 1.0185 \times 10^{-4}\))

शुद्ध जल में एक अल्प विलेय लवण \(\mathrm{A_2X_3}\) का विलेयता गुणनफल \(K_{\mathrm{sp}} = 1.1 \times 10^{-23}\) है। यह मानते हुए कि कोई भी आयन जल-अपघटित नहीं होता, \(\mathrm{A_2X_3}\) की मोलर विलेयता क्या होगी?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1
\(\mathrm{A_2X_3(s)} \rightleftharpoons 2\mathrm{A^{3+}(aq)} + 3\mathrm{X^{2-}(aq)}\). If molar solubility is \(S\), then \([\mathrm{A^{3+}}] = 2S\) and \([\mathrm{X^{2-}}] = 3S\).

Step 2
\(K_{\mathrm{sp}} = (2S)^2(3S)^3 = 4S^2 \times 27S^3 = 108S^5 = 1.1 \times 10^{-23} \implies S^5 = \frac{1.1 \times 10^{-23}}{108} \approx 1.0185 \times 10^{-25} \approx 1.0 \times 10^{-25}\). Thus, \(S = (1.0 \times 10^{-25})^{1/5} = 1.0 \times 10^{-5}\text{ mol}\cdot\text{L}^{-1}\).

Step 3: Final Answer
The molar solubility is \(1.0 \times 10^{-5}\text{ mol}\cdot\text{L}^{-1}\).

चरण 1
\(\mathrm{A_2X_3(s)} \rightleftharpoons 2\mathrm{A^{3+}} + 3\mathrm{X^{2-}}\)। \([\mathrm{A^{3+}}] = 2S\), \([\mathrm{X^{2-}}] = 3S\)।

चरण 2
\(K_{\mathrm{sp}} = 108S^5 = 1.1 \times 10^{-23} \implies S^5 \approx 1.0 \times 10^{-25} \implies S = 1.0 \times 10^{-5}\text{ mol}\cdot\text{L}^{-1}\)।

चरण 3: अंतिम उत्तर
मोलर विलेयता \(1.0 \times 10^{-5}\text{ mol}\cdot\text{L}^{-1}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_EQUILIBRIUM_NUM_Q20 - Common ion effect on nickel hydroxide solubility in strong base

questiontext.text:
The solubility product constant \(K_{\mathrm{sp}}\) of nickel(II) hydroxide \(\mathrm{Ni(OH)_2}\) is \(2.0 \times 10^{-15}\) at \(298\text{ K}\). What is its molar solubility in a \(0.10\text{ M }\\mathrm{NaOH}\) solution?

\(298\text{ K}\) पर निकेल(II) हाइड्रॉक्साइड \(\mathrm{Ni(OH)_2}\) का विलेयता गुणनफल \(K_{\mathrm{sp}} = 2.0 \times 10^{-15}\) है। \(0.10\text{ M }\\mathrm{NaOH}\) विलयन में इसकी मोलर विलेयता क्या होगी?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1
In \(0.10\text{ M }\\mathrm{NaOH}\), \([\mathrm{OH^-}] = 0.10 + 2S \approx 0.10\text{ M}\) because \(2S \ll 0.10\).

Step 2
\(K_{\mathrm{sp}} = [\mathrm{Ni^{2+}][\mathrm{OH^-}]^2 = S(0.10)^2 = 2.0 \times 10^{-15} \implies S \times 10^{-2} = 2.0 \times 10^{-15} \implies S = 2.0 \times 10^{-13}\text{ M}\).

Step 3: Final Answer
The molar solubility of \(\mathrm{Ni(OH)_2}\) in \(0.10\text{ M }\\mathrm{NaOH}\) is \(2.0 \times 10^{-13}\text{ M}\).

चरण 1
\(0.10\text{ M }\\mathrm{NaOH}\) में \([\mathrm{OH^-}] \approx 0.10\text{ M}\) क्योंकि \(2S \ll 0.10\)।

चरण 2
\(K_{\mathrm{sp}} = S(0.10)^2 = 2.0 \times 10^{-15} \implies S = 2.0 \times 10^{-13}\text{ M}\)।

चरण 3: अंतिम उत्तर
\(0.10\text{ M }\\mathrm{NaOH}\) में \(\mathrm{Ni(OH)_2}\) की मोलर विलेयता \(2.0 \times 10^{-13}\text{ M}\) है।
